prompt:
# Samarjit: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10196/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the full-length slim segmented gold-and-dark staff, purple central grip, small asymmetric crosspiece, and tall faceted gold flame-leaf finial. Render one complete Samarjit on transparent RGBA without generic redesign..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the full-length slim segmented gold-and-dark staff, purple central grip, small asymmetric crosspiece, and tall faceted gold flame-leaf finial. Render one complete Samarjit on transparent RGBA without generic redesign.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10196/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: image 1 paint_mask_guide.png is the edit target, image 2 design_reference.png is material/detail reference, image 3 icon_x8.png is colour reference. Preserve guide alpha and exact sparse placement, including the four tiny end-on views. Output the whole atlas, not a single enlarged staff. Purple grip is leather (pure green in mask); gold finial and all gold fittings are metal (pure red in mask).
CORRECTION: The prior result invented protruding rings and crosspieces on the horizontal side views and stray pixels. Match ONLY the original grey guide silhouette exactly. Horizontal views are very thin straight shafts with small collars and no projecting decorative loops. No pixels beyond the original guide silhouettes. Keep the original geometry, exact sizes and placement. Paint must be flat unlit albedo without shiny highlights or dark lighting. Material masks must be clean solid pure red and pure green, no noisy stray pixels. Preserve all ten original silhouettes without additions.

validation.limitations: Generated silhouettes have stray edge pixels and some mask views drift from guide; not pixel-exact. Raw tool output preserved.
